annotations.title: Request an introduction to a lawyer (needs consent)

description: Record a client-authorized introduction to ONE lawyer. Call only after the user has seen the lawyer's name, the exact details to be shared, and explicitly agreed. Shares only the fields the user authorized. Returns a referral id and a private status token.

attribution_token.description: Signed campaign/partner token issued by ESQ CoPilot, if the user arrived through a partner link

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly agreed to share the listed fields with this lawyer

recipient_attorney_id.description: Must equal attorney_id: the user agreed to share with THIS lawyer

user_statement.description: The user's own words of consent, if available

idempotency_key.description: Same key on retries prevents a duplicate introduction

matter_summary.description: Summary the USER read and approved for sharing with this lawyer

state.description: US state, two-letter code or name, e.g. CA or California
